messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — primary region (us-west1) GPU pool saturation detected. queue_length=12456, 95p_latency=512ms, 5xx_rate=4.8% — autoscaler reported 'scale_limit_reached'. Paging oncall.
sarah_oncall: on it. confirming impact — are we seeing client 503s or just latency spikes?
matt_sre: seeing 503 spikes for large requests (>4k tokens). small requests are delayed. logs show queueing at router level: `enqueue_time` >> 3s.
devon_ml: model-serving pools report full KV cache and OOM attempts during warmups. autoscale logs: `desired_replicas` increased but `provisioning_failures` due to GPU quota per-project.
emily_prod: notifying support. I see error buckets from two enterprise customers — higher priority SLAs. DMing them now.
sarah_oncall: ok, runbook step 1: try manual reserve in region and trigger fallback to secondary while we investigate. @matt_sre can you attempt manual scaling?
matt_sre: running manual scale command now:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --region=us-west1 --pool=primary-gpu --add-replicas=8
```
output: `error: quota_exceeded: GPU quota would exceed project limit (64 -> 72)`
sarah_oncall: damn. quota hit. next: trigger cross-region spillover to us-east1. we have automated steer but it prefers local region. force routing change.
tom_network: changing steer policy to allow spillover to us-east1 and us-central1 for 30m. applying:
```
redwoodctl routing update --policy=spillover --from=us-west1 --to=us-east1,us-central1 --threshold=80%
```
response: `applied; starting gradual shift`
devon_ml: be aware model variant in us-east1 is quantized float16-8bit — output quality slightly different for long-form. ops: set degrade-warning to customers.
emily_prod: posting status to affected customers: short degraded latency and potential small quality diffs for long completions. tagging top customers. :warning:
sarah_oncall: monitor request split. also spinning a manual emergency pool in a partner project to avoid quota; matt, can you kick a warmup there?
matt_sre: kicked warmup via partner-project, command:
```
redwoodctl pool create --project=partner-evac --region=us-east1 --machine=gpu-a100 --replicas=6 --labels=evac
```
response: `pending - nodes provisioning` — warmup logs show model weights still loading, KV warmup at 40%.
incident-bot: EVENT — routing shifted 28% traffic to us-east1, 9% to us-central1. overall 5xx rate down to 1.6% in last 2m.
sarah_oncall: good. keep an eye on queue length in us-west1 and overall latency. we need to free up capacity — any long-running jobs to evict?
devon_ml: found two batch eval jobs hogging the pool since 02:30 — flagged them. Suggest evicting non-priority batch jobs:
```
redwoodctl job cancel --job-ids=eval-2026-03-15-02:30,hyperparam-scan-314
```
result: canceled, freed ~6 replicas worth.
matt_sre: after evicting, us-west1 queue dropped by ~4200. autoscaler is now attempting to scale but still hitting per-zone limit for GPU vCPUs.
tom_network: also notice network egress to us-east1 spiked; keeping an eye on inter-region cost, but the priority is mitigation.
emily_prod: support updated customers. ticket count stabilizing, one enterprise still seeing degraded completions for long chats — set TTL to 30m for targeted fallback.
incident-bot: PAGED oncall-next (schedules) — handoff in 20m. current status: partial spillover in effect, 5xx_rate 0.9%, p95=320ms, queue_total=4123.
sarah_oncall: preparing short postmortem notes. action items: 1) request emergency GPU quota bump for us-west1, 2) improve autoscaler fallback policy to pre-emptively spill at 70% not 90%, 3) add pre-warm pools for enterprise customers during spikes, 4) evaluate partner-project fallback automation.
matt_sre: FYI provisioning errors show cloud provider rate limit on GPU allocations — need contact with cloud account team.
devon_ml: will add quality-monitoring alerts for cross-region quantized variants so we can auto-tag regressions.
oncall-next: taking handoff at +20m. I'll monitor warmups and routing. please drop any outstanding notes here and escalate to me if anything flips.
sarah_oncall: thanks team. summary: manual spillover + evictions + partner warmups reduced 5xx and started recovery. still tracking quota and provider limits. will open incident ticket and follow up with customers and cloud rep. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status=mitigated (partial), severity=high, duration so far ~48m. next update in 1h or on significant change.
